constraints: Pure refactor; the Editor class keeps every public member with the same signature, and Object.keys(new Editor()) keeps the same names and order.
Every existing test name and assertion is kept; the 17 parity blocks only move and are still collected by bun test apps/cli/src.
New modules have no module-level side effects other than constants; no regex splitting of long strings, deep recursion, per-operation closures or handler tables (the native CLI runs the code in Boa).
Moved and new packages/core code type-checks with noUncheckedIndexedAccess (design command 8).
Every verification command exits 0 once its plan's changes are in; native parity is only verified after mise run test-cli builds the release binary.
Strictly typed code in the surrounding style; no emojis; cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; no tool attribution in commits.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: a single-inheritance chain EditorCore <- ElementEditing <- SelectionEditing <- PageEditing <- NotationEditing <- Editor, because delegation stubs cannot fit about 165 signatures in 700 lines and prototype patching is a module-level side effect.
D2: component and responsive-variant members stay in Editor because they construct new Editor and their planners take the full Editor type.

D3: planner parameters are typed as the lowest chain class with the members they use; planners import chain classes only with import type (design command 9) so class extends never runs before its base is evaluated.
Only EditorCore declares fields and the constructor because useDefineForClassFields is true; requireAsset stays the last field.
D4: Batch stays a class holding state and resolvers; handlers are module-level functions under edit/operations/; the op switch stays in Batch.apply.
D5: parity tests move into apps/cli/src/native-parity/ with a non-test harness.ts; the old file is removed.
D6: only helpers newly extracted from closures or inline code get focused tests.
intentionalTradeoffs: Three serial waves give up parallelism because every gate shares one working directory, loads packages/core and builds the release binary that bundles edit-command.ts.
The class chain adds at most six prototype levels to Editor method lookup in Boa; the test-cli parity deadlines would catch a regression.
New private helpers may add prototype names; only missing names fail the export-surface check.
add-page keeps its unchecked refs.set instead of record, to avoid adding an error case.
supportedEdgeCases: Deep imports of packages/core/src/editor.ts (the private nodetto-cloud consumer) keep Editor and its re-exported types.
Default parameters such as page = this.pageId and context = this.createShapeContext() stay as written in inherited members.

unknownFieldKey with a matching path, a non-matching path and an out-of-range element index; countPageChanges with added, updated, removed and unchanged elements across pages in after-then-before order.

formatEditReport text (applied and dry run, created with and without ref, replaced, warnings) and JSON (replaced key only when non-empty; key order written, operations, created, replaced, pages, warnings).
Parity blocks report 17 skip without NODETTO_CLI_TEST_BINARY and 17 pass with it; goldenFixtures is read at registration time in documents.test.ts.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Other files near 1000 lines (packages/core/src/bpmn/notation.ts at 970) and generated sample output under examples/.
Reworking planner bodies, the edit retry loop or the parity comparison harness behavior.
